lines.line: Two people can play on one keyboard.
User A takes Stack Overflow, and User B takes Claude.
User A plays on the left of the keyboard, with W, A, S and D to move.
User B plays on the right, with the arrow keys.
Each player's moves are listed along the bottom, with their own keys.
Everything works the same as playing alone, from punches to the beam.
Here, User A uses the shield bash.
